title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20
source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne Soundboard (shinid:86905) Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD; Transfer Info: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v9.11 -> FLAC; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller and Audience (shnid:5915) MC>R>C>DAT>HD>SHN>CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a thrilling show highlighted by a soaring “The Other One” and Jerry Garcia’s tireless, hoarse‑voiced performance.
ai_review.review: All four reviewers rave about this 1973 May concert, praising the vibrant, warm and surprisingly crisp matrix mix despite minor tape hiss and cracks. The musical performance is described as nonstop energy from start to finish, with “The Other One” singled out for a spectacular guitar climax and Jerry Garcia playing on three consecutive sets. Overall the show feels like a joyous ride that rewards listeners even through its modest sonic imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Four consistent 5‑star reviews emphasize both an exceptional musical performance and an excellent matrix recording, giving the show top marks with only minor tape artifacts.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, vibrant and crisp sound praised as stellar; a few reviewers note slight tape hiss and occasional cracks but they do not detract from overall clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, continuous energy from the opening acts through the Dead’s set; the show is described as a nonstop thrill ride with seamless pacing and high‑octane transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar wails dominate The Other One’s finale; his voice is noted as slightly hoarse yet compelling, and he played in all three bands (String Band, New Riders, Dead) showing tireless stamina.
